# Downtown Fitness on West Lindsey

> A private, locally owned and operated gym at 1610 W Lindsey St, Norman, OK 73069, a few minutes from the University of Oklahoma campus. Rated 4.7 stars from 83 Google reviews (checked 16 September 2026).

## Facts
- Name: Downtown Fitness on West Lindsey (also called Downtown Fitness)
- Address: 1610 W Lindsey St, Norman, OK 73069
- Phone: (405) 801-2929
- Website: https://dfnorman.com
- Owner: Mark Floyd
- Staffed hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 8pm; Saturday and Sunday 12pm to 5pm (America/Chicago)
- Type: private gym, locally owned and operated, not a franchise
- Google rating: 4.7 from 83 reviews

## What is in the building
- Nationally trained personal training, one-on-one
- Cardio hall: treadmills, bikes and ellipticals
- Full selectorized machine floor
- Free-weight room with racks, lifting platforms, bumper plates and dumbbells to 100 lb
- Locker rooms
- Dry saunas
- High-pressure tanning booths

## Not published here
- Membership and training prices: call the desk on (405) 801-2929.
- There is no public email address.
